artworks.title: Portrait of a Man (Souvenir d'un Passage à Paris)
artworks.medium: graphite on card
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch portrait of a man's head and shoulders. The man is facing forward with a slight turn to his left. He has a mustache and unkempt hair swept back. The sketch depicts detailed facial features, including expressive eyes and a broad nose. The man's clothing is suggested with faint lines indicating a collared shirt and possibly a jacket. The background is blank, with no additional details or objects. Handwritten text above the portrait includes the date 1878.

artworks.title: Days with Celebrities: Mr. Millais, R.A.
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on bristol board
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting various scenes based on an artist's life. The central image shows the artist surrounded by different vignettes labeled with captions like "The Style," "The Thespian," "The Fashionable Beauty," and "Dining at the Garrick." The scenes illustrate activities and encounters commonly associated with artists, such as painting in the studio, socializing, and interacting with others. The drawing uses dynamic line work and diverse compositions to create a narrative with humor. The detailed illustrations may suggest a satirical approach, possibly reflecting societal norms and expectations related to artists in the past.

artworks.title: Lake Scene with Fairies and Swans
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over black chalk on blue-green board
artworks.description: This is a painting depicting figures that appear to be nymphs or spirits in flowing garments and graceful poses. Some are emerging from the sea on the left, standing on large seashells and holding pink ribbons or cloths in the air, while others are dancing on the shore to the right or sitting in a patch of green surrounded by flowers, wearing orange garments. The people all have pale pink skin. Large white swans swim on the water and more white birds are flying overhead. Small purple flowers line the bottom of the painting, and large trees curve up the left and right side with green and pale yellow leaves. The background is a pale blue color, with areas of yellow light.

artworks.title: Flying Monster
artworks.medium: watercolor with gray and gray-brown wash, graphite, and white gouache on light tan board
artworks.description: This is a painting of a mythical creature. The creature has bat-like wings and multiple heads and serpentine necks, resembling a dragon or hydra. It is depicted flying above a landscape with a muted sky. The background features a dark landscape and silhouetted birds or winged creatures. The color palette consists of soft earth tones with hints of gray and brown, giving a misty ambiance. The style is reminiscent of Hokusai, known for imaginative and dynamic scenes.

artworks.title: Fantastic Pavilions in a Grotto
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with watercolor and gouache over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a grotto scene with a rocky surface. The ceiling is high and decorated with stalactite-like formations. In the distance, there are ornate architectural forms resembling ancient ruins or columns with intricate detail. The brushstrokes are varied, contributing to an ethereal quality with a play of color and shadow. The color palette includes cool tones like blues and greens, with hints of warm colors like yellows and purples. In the foreground, there are textured rocks and small figures interacting with the surroundings, providing scale to the scene.

artworks.title: Underworld Scene with a Man and Woman Enthroned and Death Standing Guard
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache with pen and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays swirling lines and forms creating a sense of movement within an abstract composition. The shapes resemble arches and structures illuminated with blue and orange shades. Human-like figures seem seated on throne-like structures on the left. Rocky outcroppings and flowing movements on the right resemble molten lava.

artworks.title: Stage Set Consisting Of Painted Panels, Fabrics, And Fans
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache, graphite, black ink, and metallic gold paint with collage of colored velvets and watercolored paper cutouts on wove paper
artworks.description: The image features an intricate assembly of geometric shapes framed by ornate lines and decorative motifs. It has an abstract quality with layered paint textures and dynamic forms that resemble arches or windows. The composition captures elements reminiscent of fans, vases, and stylized figures in a dance-like posture. Vibrant colors and interspersed patterns suggest a patchwork of luxurious fabrics and objects that echo exquisite interior decor elements.

artworks.title: Underwater Scene
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on light tan board
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with layered elements leading towards a partially obscured horizon. The brushstrokes are fluid and create a dreamy, abstract style. The color palette is primarily cool with hints of warm tones. Swirling lines suggest foliage or mist. In the distance, there is a shimmering effect from light and dark tones.

artworks.title: Fantastic Mountainous Landscape with a Starry Sky
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache on gray-blue wove paper
artworks.description: This painting depicts a landscape with craggy mountain peaks that look almost like waves. The rocky ledge closest to us continues across the bottom of the painting up into the bottom left corner, and is mostly gray, with dark blue shadows. On the right is a dark blue and purple peak, its edges lined in white. In the center is a peak that is light blue towards the bottom and white at the top, with rays of light seeming to emit from it into the blue sky. It is surrounded by white stars.

artworks.title: "Harold Scene 3 Cathedral (The relics covered with cloth at centre)"
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with watercolor over graphite on light tan board
artworks.description: This is a painting of an interior space. The artwork features an altar with arched windows in the background. The architecture includes arches and columns. Chairs or pews are visible in the foreground. A colorful fabric drapes across the arches.

artworks.title: Incantation Scene from "Der Freischutz"
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a rocky landscape. The point of view is from a slightly elevated position, displaying a view of stones, trees, and natural elements. The horizon is not defined, as the sketch focuses on the arrangement of rocks and vegetation. The brushstrokes are expressive and loose, outlining formations with fine lines and creating depth with cross-hatching. The color palette includes beige paper and dark ink for contrast. The sketch features jagged rock shapes and tree branches in the foreground, with more rocky terrain and scattered trees in the background.

artworks.title: Castle On A Hill (Set for "Sleeping Beauty and the Beast"?)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with graphite and brown wash on wove paper

artworks.title: A Tree-lined Garden Path (Preliminary Sketch for "Sleeping Beauty and the Beast"?)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with various trees and plants from a lower ground level perspective. The horizon is subtly suggested by distant spires or structures visible through the foliage. The brushstrokes vary in thickness and detail, with bold strokes for tree trunks and finer strokes for foliage and distant elements. The color palette is predominantly sepia and black, creating a pen and ink sketch effect. Large trees frame a pathway that leads the viewer's gaze deeper into the scene, with more trees and structures visible in the distance. The background fades into lighter shades, suggesting light filtering through a dense canopy.

artworks.title: Stage Set with a Statue Of Saint George Slaying the Dragon
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache with pen and black ink over graphite, heightened with white gouache on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of an elaborate stage set design featuring a central statue of a knight on horseback. The scene includes ornate columns, pink drapery, and decorative elements highlighting themes of grandeur and opulence. Flanking the main sculpture are additional statues of figures and pillars adorned with statues at their bases, suggesting a theatrically grand setting. The background is enriched with intricate golden patterns and soft pastel hues.

artworks.title: A Fantastic Underground Temple (Aladdin's Cave?)
artworks.medium: pen and ink with watercolor and gouache over graphite on board
artworks.description: The image depicts swirling lines and jagged shapes, suggesting dynamic movement. Elements resembling ancient architectural features, including columns and archways morphing into fantastical formations, are visible. There are hints of intricate foliage or ornate carvings on the left side, evoking spirals of decorative columns. Scattered pillars with textured surfaces could be interpreted as weathered ruins, towers, or relics in a mythical cityscape or mysterious cavern.

artworks.title: Stage Set With Paintings And Statues
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on thick wove paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of an ornate stage set with sculptures and draperies. The scene features two large knight statues on pedestals, each holding banners, surrounded by ornamental designs and lions at their base. Behind them is a backdrop depicting a central oval portrait, flanked by classical figures in flowing robes with gold accents. The background also shows scenes of horsemen in action. The composition is framed by deep pink drapery with golden embellishments, following the style of historical European theatrical set designs.

artworks.title: Interior of an Ancient Egyptian Temple
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache with pen and brown ink over graphite on thick wove paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of an interior with statues. The image features a large, interior space with walls adorned with faded, painted figures. There are two statues of figures on plinths facing each other across a hallway leading to an outdoor space. In the forefront is a statue of a black cat sitting on a pedestal. Light from the outside illuminates parts of the interior, casting shadows. The style of painting is characterized by loose brushstrokes and a muted color palette, with blue skies and patches of green visible through an arched exit.

artworks.title: View of Muhlendamm
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash over traces of graphite, heightened with touches of white gouache (partially oxidized) on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a busy street scene from a slightly elevated viewpoint. On the right, there is a grand urban building with intricate architectural details, while the left side shows rows of buildings extending into the distance. The composition is detailed, likely done with pen and wash technique. The color scheme is monochromatic, dominated by sepia tones, lending a historical feel. The street is filled with numerous figures in period attire, engaging in various activities like talking and observing, implying a social gathering.

artworks.title: A Smiling Boy with Flowing Hair
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person's head and shoulders. The person is facing forward with a slight tilt to the left. Their facial features show a smiling expression, with joyfully squinted eyes and a broad grin. The person's hair is shoulder-length with soft curls framing the face. The drawing implies the presence of a garment, possibly a shirt, with hints of a collar or scarf around the neck. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects in the person's hands. The background is plain without any additional elements or scenery.

artworks.title: Figures at a Church Service
artworks.medium: graphite, with pen and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows three figures seated. In the center, a woman sits with a baby in her arms. To the left, a child is seated on an elevated surface, holding a hat. In the background, there is a decorative pulpit or architectural structure.

artworks.title: The Stoning of Saint Stephen
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of multiple human figures in dynamic poses. The figures are reaching upwards or looking at others on clouds. They have minimal facial features and simple hair. The clothing is long and flowing, adding to the sense of movement. Some figures have wings. Above them, a group is seated on and around clouds, with one central figure. The background includes clouds and a structured edifice.

artworks.title: Santa Maria a Cetrella, Anacapri
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite
artworks.description: This painting shows a dilapidated white building placed atop rugged, rocky terrain, a blue body of water visible in the distance below. The building is surrounded by a wall that slopes diagonally downward with the face of the mountain. The wall is mostly white, but the plaster appears to have fallen off in places, exposing red bricks. In other places, there are deep cracks or vines creeping across the surface. The walls of the building behind are also cracked, and it has a small white tower and two round domes. The painting is lit dramatically, with the reddish-gray rocks nearest to us in shadow, and the building lit by bright light.  The water near the top right corner is a deep blue, and the sky above scene is blue with some fluffy white clouds.

artworks.title: Two Draft Horses
artworks.medium: black and white chalk on gray-green wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two horses standing in a stable. The drawing shows a pair of horses, one dark and one lighter in color, tethered within a stable setting. The horses are dressed in harnesses and standing side by side. The artist has used shading and texture to depict details such as the musculature of the horses and their harnesses. The background is softly rendered, hinting at a wall or barrier in the stable.

artworks.title: Allegory of Sculpture
artworks.medium: red chalk with pen and brown ink and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length nude male figure standing in a contrapposto position with a serious expression and distinct facial features. A seated individual in flowing drapery holds a book and observes the standing figure. A sculpted head lies on the floor with carving tools scattered around. In the background, two smaller statues and a sculpted bust are featured on a ledge, along with a partial bust emerging from a stone block. The setting is an artist's studio with a plain wall in the background.
